note: Off NH-49 less than 2 miles from I-93 exit 28, the first national forest campground north on the interstate, with sites spread among old white pines. Campton Pond and the Mad River are nearby, across the highway; sites 33-58 are nearest the flush toilets and showers. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov facility/rates/catalog: 58 sites (40 RV-capable, 37 take 23 ft+, max 50, all back-in), sites 033-058 reservable and 001-032 first-come, $30 + $6 extra vehicle, flush toilets/water/coin showers, mid-May to mid-October, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone should be the concessionaire's or district's, not the rec.gov call centre.
flags: PHONE: 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov call centre) -> 802-289-0970 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970', the concessionaire; email whitemountaincampgrounds@goexplorus.com). The FS page footer gives the WMNF Supervisor's Office (603) 536-6100, also usable.

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. Every rec.gov site point lies north of NH-49 under continuous pine canopy (Esri 43.8737,-71.6255); the Mad River runs south of the highway, ~200 m+ from the nearest sites.
Rig length: 37 of 40 RV/trailer sites take 23 ft+ (rec.gov catalog); 15 tent-only.
Pin 43.87345,-71.62672 (= FS page lat/long) is on the west part of the loops near sites 20-29, ~100 m from the all-site centroid; no move.

Kancamagus/WMNF pass: not on the Kancamagus; concessionaire campground. FS passes page (read for 4122) says concessionaire campgrounds are not covered by the WMNF recreation pass; the site fee is the charge.
